issue.title: bob-cli zsh first-tab completion flakes under the full parallel suite
issue.description: On the sase-1g6.4 tree, `cargo test --test cli completion::zsh_adapter::real_zsh_first_tab_completes` failed once inside the full parallel suite with "zpty driver failed" after the test had already printed SETUP OK and FIRST-TAB OK. The same test passed when rerun in isolation on that tree and on clean origin/master. Fail rate observed: 1 failure in 1 full-suite run, then pass in isolation. Not reproduced serially. The test lives at tests/cli/completion/zsh_adapter.rs::real_zsh_first_tab_completes. This is unrelated to highlights audio; the listen-card diff does not touch the zsh adapter.
